remarks: Welcome to 21 Getner Trail, a tranquil condo complex with beautifully styled stand-alone homes that provide a unique living experience in a community setting. As you enter through the gates and drive past the charming horseback riding training center, you'll find yourself at a cape cod style home that perfectly blends comfortable living with classic charm.  Step inside to discover a spacious 2,209 sq. ft. layout featuring a highly desirable first-floor primary bedroom suite, providing comfort and convenient access. Additionally, the main level boasts a cozy den, perfect for relaxing or working from home, along with a renovated kitchen with stainless steel appliances and an island with seating for two, seamlessly flowing into the dining and living room areas. A first-floor powder room and nearby laundry room add to the home's practical design.  Venture upstairs to find two additional bedrooms that share a full bath, providing ample room for guests or a home office. The full-sized, walk-out finished basement is a versatile space with great natural light, perfect for a family room and game area. The oversized deck is accessible from both the dining room and primary bedroom.  Located on the Darien/Norwalk border, Getner Farms is ideally located to beaches, shopping and all transportation hubs. *On the market for both condo and single family home. It stands alone but is a part of an association. See agent remarks regarding offers.
